column1: # optlevel-bench: emitted-code gain per unit of compile cost, instructions retired
# noise floor (base measured twice): self 0.0010%  corpus 0.0009%  kernels max 0.0000%
# gain>0 means the flag makes the emitted program retire fewer instructions; cost>0 means it makes the compiler retire more

# kernels_moved is the subject size of every kernel-derived column. At 0/17 the subject set is EMPTY and gain_pct, efficiency, text_kernels_pct and best_kernel read n/a -- a geomean over bit-identical binaries is not a measurement of zero effect, it is the absence of one. Quote kernels_moved, never gain_pct, on such a row.
